title: 动火作业安全知识自测

author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/10_Test Your Hot Work Safety Knowledge Hot Work Safety Quiz Hot Work Safety MCQs Te/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着焊接面罩掀起来，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot lifts a welding face shield up from its face and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天用十道题，聊聊动火作业安全。

shots.scene: 一行图标：火焰、气瓶、砂轮、焊枪
shots.prompt_en: A row of simple icons: a flame, a gas cylinder, a grinding wheel and a welding torch. No people.
shots.narration: 气割、焊接、打磨，都会产生明火火花。

shots.scene: 厂区里，老李推着焊接设备小车走来
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pushes a cart with welding equipment and two gas cylinders across a workshop yard.
shots.narration: 老李要去做气割和焊接。

shots.scene: 阿杰好奇地跟在后面
shots.prompt_en: The young male student follows the facility engineer curiously.
shots.narration: 阿杰用过砂轮，想来帮忙。

shots.scene: 老李对阿杰竖起手指，示意先学再动手
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer raises one finger to the young male student, telling him to learn first.
shots.narration: 老李说：先答对这十道题再说。

shots.scene: 气割割炬、软管、气瓶连成一线，火焰往回窜的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram: a cutting torch, a hose and a gas cylinder in a line, with a red arrow of flame running back toward the cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：气割时防回火传播，用什么？

shots.scene: 软管接口处装上一个小圆柱装置，红箭头被挡住
shots.prompt_en: A small cylindrical device is fitted at the hose connection and the red arrow is stopped there. No people.
shots.narration: 选项：回火阻止器、回火防止器、阻火器。

shots.scene: 欣欣点头，指着装置
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods and points at the small device on the hose.
shots.narration: 答案B，回火防止器。

shots.scene: 两只气瓶，一只直立一只横躺
shots.prompt_en: Two gas cylinders: one standing upright, one lying on its side on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：气瓶该怎么放？

shots.scene: 直立的气瓶打勾
shots.prompt_en: The upright cylinder gets a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案A，始终直立存放。

shots.scene: 砂轮机和一片砂轮，旁边两个转速表图标
shots.prompt_en: A bench grinder and a grinding wheel with two blank dial gauge icons beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：机器转速和砂轮额定转速比？

shots.scene: 机器转速表指针低于砂轮转速表，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The machine dial needle sits below the wheel dial needle, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，等于或小于砂轮的转速。

shots.scene: 老李站在气瓶前，手拿空白检查表
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands beside a gas cylinder holding a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 第四题：气瓶用前要查哪些？

shots.scene: 瓶帽和阀门专用扳手的图标，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cylinder cap and a valve wrench, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶帽和阀门扳手要齐全。

shots.scene: 软管接头上涂肥皂水，冒出小气泡
shots.prompt_en: Soapy water brushed on a hose connection shows small bubbles. No people.
shots.narration: 用肥皂水查漏，冒泡就是漏气。

shots.scene: 接头处的回火防止器，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The flashback device at the hose connection gets a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 回火防止器也要装好。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起写着勾的卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a card with three check marks.
shots.narration: 答案D，以上都要。

shots.scene: 一片砂轮挂在手指上，小锤轻敲，音符飘出
shots.prompt_en: A grinding wheel hangs from a finger while a small wooden mallet taps it lightly; music notes float out. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：砂轮装前怎么检查？

shots.scene: 清脆的音符与沉闷的音符对比
shots.prompt_en: Clear bright music notes on one side and dull broken notes on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 声音清脆是好的，发闷可能有裂纹。

shots.scene: 敲击图标打勾，加热冷却图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: The tapping icon gets a green check while a heating icon and a cooling icon are crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 不是加热、冷却试验，答案C敲击检查。

shots.scene: 一把电钻，旁边三个图标：双方框、手掌、电缆
shots.prompt_en: A power drill with three icons beside it: a double square symbol, an open hand and a cable. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：电动工具要具备什么？

shots.scene: 手柄外壳上出现两层颜色的剖面
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of the tool handle shows two separate insulating layers. No people.
shots.narration: 双重绝缘的手柄，

shots.scene: 手松开开关，工具立即停止的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand releasing a trigger and the tool stopping instantly. No people.
shots.narration: 失手即停的开关，

shots.scene: 电缆剖面显示两层绝缘
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of a power cable showing two insulating layers. No people.
shots.narration: 还有双重绝缘的电缆。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 答案D，三样都要。

shots.scene: 气瓶存放间，阴凉通风，有百叶窗
shots.prompt_en: A cool gas cylinder storage room with louvered vents and upright chained cylinders. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：气瓶该存在哪里？

shots.scene: 气瓶远离一桶溶剂，箭头标出距离
shots.prompt_en: Cylinders placed far from a drum of flammable liquid with a long arrow between them. No people.
shots.narration: 远离可燃物，

shots.scene: 焊接火花飞溅区与气瓶之间隔开
shots.prompt_en: A welding spark zone far away from the cylinders. No people.
shots.narration: 远离动火作业点，

shots.scene: 百叶窗通风，气瓶在阴凉处
shots.prompt_en: Cylinders standing in a shaded storage area with louvered vents. No people.
shots.narration: 存在阴凉通风的地方。

shots.scene: 欣欣点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods.
shots.narration: 答案D，以上都对。

shots.scene: 焊机、焊钳和工件，回路线夹在工件旁边
shots.prompt_en: A welding machine with its return cable clamped right next to the workpiece. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：焊机回路线接在哪里？

shots.scene: 回路线夹在附近的管道上，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A return cable clamped to a nearby pipe, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不是附近任何金属，也不是任意位置。

shots.scene: 老李把回路线夹在工件旁，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer clamps the return cable right next to the workpiece; a green check appears.
shots.narration: 答案A，接在离工件最近的位置。

shots.scene: 气瓶阀门旁的安全泄压装置特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a small pressure relief device beside a cylinder valve. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：气瓶安全泄压装置做什么？

shots.scene: 压力表指针升高，装置喷出一股气
shots.prompt_en: A blank gauge needle rises and the relief device releases a puff of gas. No people.
shots.narration: 压力过高时自动泄压，

shots.scene: 气瓶被火烤热，装置放出气体
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder heated by nearby flames releases gas through the relief device. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶过热时放出气体。

shots.scene: 两个图标都打勾
shots.prompt_en: The over-pressure icon and the overheating icon both get green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，两者都是。

shots.scene: 焊接现场的三个图标：强光、火花、烟雾
shots.prompt_en: Three icons around a welding spot: a bright light burst, flying sparks and a gray fume cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：焊接会产生哪些危害？

shots.scene: 强光图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: A bright light burst icon glows. No people.
shots.narration: 强光，

shots.scene: 火花四溅图标
shots.prompt_en: A flying sparks icon. No people.
shots.narration: 飞溅的火花，

shots.scene: 灰色烟雾图标
shots.prompt_en: A gray toxic fume cloud icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还有有毒烟尘。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起三张卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up three cards together.
shots.narration: 答案D，以上都是。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上气瓶、砂轮、焊枪三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard showing a cylinder, a grinding wheel and a welding torch icon.
shots.narration: 回火防止器，气瓶直立，用前检查。

shots.scene: 砂轮和电钻的图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a grinding wheel and a power drill with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 转速不超砂轮，敲击检查，双重绝缘。

shots.scene: 气瓶存放间和焊机回路线图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cool ventilated cylinder store and a return cable clamped next to a workpiece. No people.
shots.narration: 阴凉通风存气瓶，回路线就近接。

shots.scene: 阿杰答完题，老李点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finishes the quiz and the facility engineer nods approvingly.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：十题都答对了！

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别，身后是整齐的气瓶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of neatly stored upright gas cylinders.
shots.narration: 动火十问到这里，下次见！
